thread:
Alexa (Marketing): Heads up — we need a final cadence for LinkedIn + X for the Beta launch on Thurs. Short thread + one long LinkedIn post. Can we lock times and CTAs?
Joel (Growth): For X I think 3 tweets: tease (AM), product highlight (launch minute), signup push (evening). CTA variants: sign up / join waitlist / demo. Which holds for LI?
Alexa (Marketing): LI: one long narrative at 10am PST (founder quote + benchmark stat), plus a shorter follow-up (customer quote) at 2pm PST. Use same CTA: join waitlist. Keep messaging consistent with benchmark doc — emphasize "predictable inference economics" and latency comparison.
Sam (Design): I can whip up two image cards: 1) benchmark bar chart, 2) founder quote. Need final copy by EOD tomorrow. Any color/theme notes?
Alexa (Marketing): Use the launch palette (blue+yellow) and the short chart style from last benchmark. Note: we must show % cost reduction vs baseline, not absolute $s.
Zara (Ops): Who's routing inbound leads? We should map UTM -> SDR queue and a follow-up template. MKT Bot will tag leads in the lead inbox.
Joel (Growth): Route UTM campaign=beta_launch to SDR queue "beta-sdr". Add tag "priority:launch". Follow-up cadence: 24h email -> 3 day nurture -> 10 day checkin. Can we sketch the email copy here?
Alexa (Marketing): Draft follow-up copy (short):

MKT Bot: New campaign created: beta_launch -> beta-sdr (tag: priority:launch)

Joel (Growth): Draft email (short):
"Hi {{first_name}},
We noticed you signed up for Redwood Beta — would love to give you a quick walkthrough of latency and cost optimizations. Book a 15-min slot: https://cal.com/redwood/beta
Best, Joel"

Sam (Design): Quick sample post for X thread (feel free to tweak):
```
Tweet 1: Beta launch Thurs — serving LLMs faster and cheaper. TL;DR: 3x throughput gains. 👇
Tweet 2: Benchmark: average lat < 120ms for production workloads. Our secret: smart batching + KV cache.
Tweet 3: Try Beta -> https://redwood.ai/beta (UTM=beta_launch) Join waitlist.
```

Alexa (Marketing): Love it. Can we A/B the CTA on X: direct sign up vs demo link? Split 50/50 for the signup push tweet. Joel to set UTM variants.

Joel (Growth): Will set UTMs: utm_medium=x_post, utm_campaign=beta_launch, utm_content=signup_vs_demo. I'll drop the tracking sheet in #marketing-assets.

Sam (Design): Uploaded two images to the assets folder: "bench-chart-v2.png" and "founder-quote-card.png". Small ask: tweak chart so the bars have labels and % deltas.

Alexa (Marketing): Noted. Also want a short pinned reply for the X thread with an FAQ link and webinar signup: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_campaign=beta_launch_webinar

Zara (Ops): Webinar routing: attendees -> webinar-leads queue, add tag webinar:beta. SDR playbook: immediate email + webinar replay drip. I'll add the automation.

Alexa (Marketing): Two final asks: 1) Sam, export a 3:2 version of the chart for LI. 2) Joel, set the A/B posting times and update tracking sheet. We go live Thurs 10:00 PST (LI post) and X cadence throughout the day.

Sam (Design): On it. ETA 24h.

Joel (Growth): I'll set the A/B and post schedule in Buffer and share the CSV. Quick CSV sample I'll use for ingest:
```
platform,post_time,variant,utm_content,asset
x,2028-05-18T09:00:00Z,tease,tease_v1,bench-chart-v2.png
li,2028-05-18T10:00:00Z,main,signup,founder-quote-card.png
x,2028-05-18T17:00:00Z,signup,signup_vA,bench-chart-v2.png
x,2028-05-18T17:00:00Z,signup,signup_vB,bench-chart-v2.png
```

MKT Bot: Reminder scheduled: post-check at 2028-05-18T08:00:00Z.

Alexa (Marketing): Perfect. After launch we'll pull early engagement metrics at +6h and +24h and decide if we need a paid boost. Thanks team :rocket:
